Column.description: Vertical layout of its children (A2UI basic layout).

Text.description: A short assistant message in plain text. Never course content.

ChoiceChips.description: Interview question answered with chips. Use for short categorical answers (tone, audience, assessments); `multiple` allows several chips. The author can also type a custom answer when `allowCustom` is true.

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

defaultValue.description: Values used by Decide for me

SingleChoice.description: Interview question with one answer from a short list shown as radio cards (e.g. level).

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

defaultValue.description: Value used by Decide for me

DurationSlider.description: Interview question for the total course length and the lesson length, in minutes.

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

LanguagePicker.description: Interview question for the course language (ISO 639-1 codes).

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

options.description: Languages, value is the ISO code

DecideForMe.description: Button that fills every open interview question with its default and explains the choices.

SourceCard.description: An uploaded source: file, processing status and its section tree with fragment ids.

CitationChip.description: Amber chip linking an element to the source fragment it comes from.

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

OutlineDiff.description: Proposed course outline as a reviewable diff: modules, lessons with learning objectives and citations, added/changed/removed marks, inline objective edits, approve or request changes.

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios
Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios
Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

GenerationProgress.description: Stage timeline, per-lesson status with retry for a failed step, and the running cost.

LessonPreviewCard.description: A generated lesson rendered for review, with citation chips and actions (edit in chat, view sources).

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

QuizQuestionCard.description: One quiz question with its answers, the correct ones marked, the explanation and its cited fragment.

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

DiffView.description: Before/after of a proposed change to one element, block by block with word-level marks; approve or reject.

elementLabel.description: Element shown to the author, e.g. Lesson 2.1 › Q2

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

ApplySummary.description: What applying the blueprint will create, update and delete in the LMS, with warnings; approve to apply.

VersionList.description: Blueprint version history with origin and status; restore any version.

CostMeter.description: Running AI cost of the session against its budget.
